items.title: BOJ diperkirakan akan menaikkan suku bunga sebesar 25 basis poin ke level tertinggi baru dalam tiga dekade: survei CNBC
items.summary: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

items.title: Imbal hasil Treasury 10-tahun naik kembali menjadi 5% setelah Fed menaikkan suku bunga, Warsh menyoroti risiko inflasi
items.summary: The 10-year yield moved above the 5% mark after a Federal Reserve rate increase and comments from Chairman Kevin Warsh highlighting persistent inflation risks.

items.summary: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

items.title: Oil prices fall after U.S. says damaged Saudi pipeline will restart operations in days
items.summary: The pipeline has allowed the Saudis to shift oil exports to the Red Sea while the U.S. and Iran battle for control over Hormuz.

items.title: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
items.summary: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.
